integrity: Two standard-library verifiers recompute all faces, an exhaustive acyclic discrete-Morse matching, and independent mod-two boundary ranks. Integral homotopy follows from Forman Morse theory and nullity of \(\pi_2(S^1)\). Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite graph and ordinary open-neighborhood complex only; nonequivariant homotopy; no assertion for other 24-cell graph constructions, deformations or box-complex symmetry actions; priority not fully certified.
title: The 24-cell neighborhood complex is \(S^1\vee\bigvee^{48}S^3\)
